_layer: STATIC — automatic checks after each image. Any FAIL -> regenerate (max 2 retries) -> /Rejected + alert.

checks.rule: product shape, proportions and item count match the raw image
mean product-region colour within Delta-E 5 of raw cut-out
brand name and key label words in the output match OCR of the raw image
checks.threshold: all brand words present, no new words

checks.rule: CLIP/DINO similarity of product crop vs raw cut-out
no hard-edged shadows, no specular hot spots, no direct sunlight look
product is the clear focal point; frame-fill within the shot's range
prop count within shot limit, no branded props, no competitor products, realistic scale
no extra text, watermark, sparkle mark, warped hands or geometry
product mask does not touch frame edge; >= 8% margin

retry_policy.on_retry: add the failed check's reason to the prompt as an explicit correction; keep the same seed scene
retry_policy.after_max: move to /Rejected, set sheet status = needs_review, send daily summary

publish_gate: all 5 shots PASS -> Shopify product status = draft. Switch to active only after the team approves the first 50 SKUs.
